$schema: coverage.registry — HAND-MAINTAINED. The ONLY hand-edited coverage file.
$docs: See docs/execution/GARNISH_COVERAGE_03_REPORT.md. Each entry is a deliberate decision with a one-line reason.

statusGrammar.frontend:<route/component>: Must surface on the frontend AND is verified mapped (route/call) or rendered (Recipe detail heuristic). Losing the mapping BLOCKS.
statusGrammar.must-render: Belongs on the frontend but is NOT yet surfaced — acknowledged debt. Non-blocking; surfaced in the gap report.
statusGrammar.internal: Never user-facing (FKs, internal flags, dev probes, shadow/governance internals).
statusGrammar.deferred:<epic/reason>: Intentionally postponed to a named epic. Non-blocking; surfaced in the gap report.

notes: Field-level coverage is enforced for trackedFieldEntities (Recipe). Other models are tracked at the model level, not field level.
Endpoints under the internal/ path prefix are auto-classified internal and need no explicit entry.

A frontend:recipe-detail/* field is verified via the (heuristic) detail-page render scan. A frontend:* field on another surface (e.g. recipe-card) is treated as mapped-but-unverified (the heuristic only scans the detail page).
